verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated sandbox or staging feature, but the docs show Meilisearch runs as a single binary with no dependencies. It can be installed locally via cURL, Docker, Homebrew or APT, and the official Docker images are pitched for 'development', so users can spin up an isolated test instance separate from production. A community report of a one-click Docker install corroborates how easy throwaway instances are, but this is a self-managed workaround rather than a first-class sandbox. missing for 10: a first-party sandbox/staging environment on Cloud, documented dev-vs-production project separation, guidance on cloning or seeding test data, and test-environment workflows for agents/MCP.
